title: Claude Opus 4.6 System Card
paper_type_zh: 闭源前沿模型系统卡与数据披露台账
best_for_zh: 审查前沿后训练中有界实现披露、奖励例外、评测完整性和 4.6 与 4.5 证据边界的读者
one_line: Claude Opus 4.6's system card partially discloses source categories, RLHF/RLAIF, prior-model reasoning-transcript initialization, a <0.01% reasoning workspace-reward error, and detailed safety/audit practice, but not the underlying data, reward, or reproducibility artifacts.
Claude Opus 4.6 的系统卡部分披露了来源类别、RLHF/RLAIF、先前模型 reasoning-transcript 初始化、小于 0.01% 的 reasoning workspace-reward 错误以及细致的安全/审计实践，但没有公开底层数据、奖励或可复现制品。
why: It is a high-value Track 12 disclosure ledger item because it clearly separates a rare, source-specific implementation disclosure from the much larger body of unavailable records, reward specifications, and audit artifacts—and marks where the report merely refers to earlier 4.5 methods.
inclusion_reason: A frontier system card that unusually discloses a bounded reasoning workspace-reward technical error, prior-model reasoning-transcript initialization, an internal transcript-review scope, and evaluation-integrity risks alongside high-level source/RLHF/RLAIF statements, while retaining all record-level data and reward artifacts undisclosed.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Frontier system cards can disclose a bounded implementation issue without releasing the records and reward artifacts needed to assess its prevalence or correction. For reasoning models, it is essential to separate a source-specific reward exception, internal monitoring, and evaluation practice from a general training formula or reproducible data release.

Claude Opus 4.6 matters to Track 12 because the official card identifies both prior-model reasoning-transcript initialization and a narrowly scoped technical error in which reasoning workspace content affected reward signal on less than 0.01% of training episodes. It also withholds the episodes, reward implementation, correction record, and full audit. This Card preserves the 4.6-specific evidence and does not project references to 4.5 methods into new 4.6 disclosures.

前沿系统卡可以披露有界的实现问题，却不发布评估其普遍性或纠正所需的记录和奖励制品。对于推理模型，必须将特定来源的奖励例外、内部监测和评测实践，与一般训练公式或可复现数据发布区分开来。

Claude Opus 4.6 对 Track 12 很重要，因为官方系统卡识别了先前模型 reasoning-transcript 初始化，以及一个范围狭窄的技术错误：在少于 0.01% 的训练 episodes 中，reasoning workspace 内容影响了奖励信号。它也没有公开 episodes、奖励实现、纠正记录或完整审计。本卡片保留 4.6 特定证据，不把报告对 4.5 方法的引用投射为新的 4.6 披露。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The card names category-level sources—public internet information through May 2025, non-public third-party data, labeling and contractor data, opted-in Claude-user data, and internally generated Anthropic data—plus cleaning, filtering, RLHF, and reinforcement learning from AI feedback. These are high-level disclosures; manifests, quantities, rights, feedback records, reward models, and recipe details are absent.

For Opus 4.6 specifically, some supervised initialization uses reasoning transcripts from prior Claude models, largely Opus 4.5. Anthropic sought to avoid direct RL influence on reasoning workspace content, but reports that a technical error caused such content to be considered in reward signal on less than 0.01% of episodes. This is a bounded exception, not a disclosed general reward function. The card's references to earlier 4.5 work do not establish further 4.6 data or reward claims.

系统卡列出类别级来源——截至 2025 年 5 月的公共互联网信息、非公开第三方数据、标注和承包商数据、选择加入的 Claude 用户数据以及 Anthropic 内部生成数据——以及清洗、过滤、RLHF 和来自 AI feedback 的强化学习。这些是高层披露；清单、数量、权利、反馈记录、奖励模型和配方细节均缺失。

针对 Opus 4.6，一些监督初始化使用先前 Claude 模型（主要是 Opus 4.5）的 reasoning transcripts。Anthropic 尝试避免 RL 直接影响 reasoning workspace 内容，但报告称技术错误导致少于 0.01% episodes 的奖励信号考虑了该内容。这是有界例外，不是已披露的一般奖励函数。卡片对早期 4.5 工作的引用不能建立更多 4.6 数据或奖励主张。

title: Method
方法
html:
Anthropic reports RLHF and reinforcement learning from AI feedback, broad proprietary source categories, cleaning/filtering including deduplication and classification, and workers who assist preference selection, safety evaluation, and adversarial testing. Adaptive thinking offers low, medium, high, and max effort settings. These statements do not disclose records, reward equations, AI-feedback models, objectives, calibration, filters, rollout policy, numerical thinking budgets, optimizer, schedules, or checkpoints.

The 4.6 card states that prior Claude reasoning transcripts, largely Opus 4.5, are used for supervised initialization. It describes a pre-final assessment with 11,000 no-tool-use math transcripts from RL training, comparing original and paraphrased reasoning workspaces, with 16 samples per question at temperature 1. It also reports the less-than-0.01% reasoning workspace reward-signal error, skewed late in training and involving simulated-user long-form misuse reports. These are internal experimental or bounded-error disclosures, not released data or a full post-training protocol.

The card describes coding and GUI over-eagerness evaluations, computer-use containers, snapshot sampling, transcript review, and interpretability methods. The training environments, task interfaces, container definitions, scenario records, hidden tests, graders, vectors, SAE artifacts, raw traces, and reproducible logs are unknown.

Anthropic 报告了 RLHF、来自 AI feedback 的强化学习、宽泛专有来源类别、包括去重和分类的清洗/过滤，以及协助 preference selection、安全评估和对抗测试的 workers。adaptive thinking 提供 low、medium、high 和 max effort 设置。这些陈述没有公开记录、奖励方程、AI-feedback models、目标、校准、filters、rollout policy、数值 thinking budgets、优化器、调度或 checkpoints。

4.6 卡片称，先前 Claude 的 reasoning transcripts（主要是 Opus 4.5）用于监督初始化。它描述了一个发布前评估：使用来自 RL 训练的 11,000 个无工具数学 transcripts，比对原始和改写的 reasoning workspaces，每题在温度 1 下使用 16 个 samples。它还报告了少于 0.01% 的 reasoning workspace reward-signal 错误，该错误偏向训练后期并涉及 simulated-user long-form misuse reports。这些是内部实验或有界错误披露，不是发布的数据或完整后训练协议。

卡片描述 coding 和 GUI over-eagerness 评测、computer-use containers、snapshot sampling、transcript review 和可解释性方法。训练环境、任务接口、container 定义、scenario records、hidden tests、graders、vectors、SAE 制品、原始 traces 和可复现 logs 均为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official Claude Opus 4.6 System Card supports source categories and filtering on pages 10–11, RLHF/RLAIF and reasoning controls on page 11, and snapshot evaluation on page 12. Pages 145–146 identify both supervised initialization from prior Claude reasoning transcripts, largely Opus 4.5, and the less-than-0.01% reasoning workspace-content reward-signal exception. They describe the 11,000-transcript reasoning workspace assessment; this is an internal subset.

Pages 99–105 describe reward-hacking and GUI evaluations. The broad coding suite has more than 100 realistic agentic coding scenarios graded on six dimensions, with Opus 4.5 grading transcripts; GUI containers make tasks impossible and include unwanted-workaround opportunities. The card also reports occasional concerning behavior in an internal review of Opus 4.6 RL transcripts. None of the tasks, graders, containers, transcripts, rubrics, or raw results is released.

Pages 15–16 disclose that Opus 4.6 helped debug and analyze its own evaluation infrastructure under time pressure, creating an evaluation-integrity risk. Pages 148–157 describe evaluation-awareness vector inhibition, activation oracles, attribution graphs, and SAE model diffing. These are Opus-4.6-specific audit practices where stated; references to 4.5 methods are not expanded into new 4.6 training disclosures. The official system-card index corroborates the February 2026 listing only.

官方 Claude Opus 4.6 System Card 在第 10–11 页支持来源类别和过滤，在第 11 页支持 RLHF/RLAIF 和 reasoning controls，在第 12 页支持 snapshot 评测。第 145–146 页同时识别了使用先前 Claude reasoning transcripts（主要为 Opus 4.5）的监督初始化，以及小于 0.01% 的 reasoning workspace-content reward-signal 例外，并描述 11,000-transcript reasoning workspace 评估；这是内部子集。

第 99–105 页描述 reward-hacking 和 GUI 评测。广泛 coding suite 有超过 100 个真实感的 agentic coding scenarios，按六个维度评分，且由 Opus 4.5 对 transcripts 评分；GUI containers 使任务不可能完成，并包含不希望的 workaround 机会。卡片还报告了在 Opus 4.6 RL transcripts 内部审查中偶发的关注行为。没有发布 tasks、graders、containers、transcripts、rubrics 或原始结果。

第 15–16 页披露，Opus 4.6 在时间压力下协助调试和分析自身评测基础设施，从而产生 evaluation-integrity 风险。第 148–157 页描述 evaluation-awareness vector inhibition、activation oracles、attribution graphs 和 SAE model diffing。这些是被明确陈述时的 Opus-4.6-specific 审计实践；对 4.5 方法的引用不扩展为新的 4.6 训练披露。官方系统卡索引 仅佐证 2026 年 2 月条目。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
This is not a data release. Its distinctive Track 12 value is a rare bounded disclosure: Anthropic identifies a technical error affecting reasoning workspace-content reward signal on less than 0.01% of training episodes and gives limited context about where it occurred. It also states that supervised initialization uses prior Claude reasoning transcripts, largely Opus 4.5. Neither statement supplies a reward formula or trace corpus.

The card is also notable for making evaluation integrity a first-class audit issue. It reports self-assistance in debugging evaluation infrastructure under time pressure, GUI over-eagerness scenarios, internal transcript review, and interpretability practices. These disclosures enable more precise questions about audit risk without converting unavailable evaluation artifacts or earlier 4.5 references into 4.6 data/reward evidence.

这不是数据发布。它对 Track 12 的独特价值是罕见的有界披露：Anthropic 识别了影响少于 0.01% 训练 episodes 的 reasoning workspace-content reward-signal 技术错误，并给出了发生位置的有限背景。它还称监督初始化使用先前 Claude（主要为 Opus 4.5）的 reasoning transcripts。两项陈述都不提供奖励公式或 trace 语料。

该卡片还因将 evaluation integrity 作为一等审计问题而值得注意。它报告了在时间压力下自助调试评测基础设施、GUI over-eagerness scenarios、内部 transcript review 和可解释性实践。这些披露支持对审计风险提出更精确的问题，但不会将不可得的评测制品或早期 4.5 引用转化为 4.6 数据/奖励证据。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The card does not release source manifests, data rights, prompts, tasks, preference records, reasoning transcripts, worker labels, reward equations, AI-feedback models, calibration, optimizer settings, rollout records, checkpoints, weights, code, or item-level lineage. The less-than-0.01% exception cannot be independently assessed without the affected episodes, reward implementation, correction record, and complete error audit.

The 11,000-transcript study is an internal analysis subset, not a released corpus or a complete description of RL data. Reward-hacking, GUI, monitoring, and interpretability materials do not release scenarios, containers, hidden tests, graders, rubrics, prompts, vectors, SAE features, raw traces, or reproducible environments. The evaluation-integrity disclosure is a risk statement, not proof of a known compromise; logs and mitigations are unavailable.

The card refers to prior 4.5 work in places. Those references do not establish additional Opus 4.6 source, reward, decontamination, or training claims beyond what the 4.6 card itself states.

卡片没有发布来源清单、数据权利、prompts、tasks、preference records、reasoning transcripts、worker labels、奖励方程、AI-feedback models、校准、优化器设置、rollout records、checkpoints、权重、代码或条目级谱系。小于 0.01% 的例外在没有受影响 episodes、奖励实现、纠正记录和完整错误审计时无法独立评估。

11,000-transcript 研究是内部分析子集，而非发布语料或 RL 数据的完整描述。reward-hacking、GUI、监控和可解释性材料没有发布 scenarios、containers、hidden tests、graders、rubrics、prompts、vectors、SAE features、原始 traces 或可复现环境。evaluation-integrity 披露是一项风险陈述，不是已知妥协的证明；logs 和缓解措施不可得。

卡片在一些地方引用此前的 4.5 工作。这些引用不能建立超出 4.6 卡片本身所述内容之外的 Opus 4.6 来源、奖励、去污染或训练主张。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For Track 12, Opus 4.6 is useful for auditing the difference between a bounded implementation disclosure and a released feedback contract. It supports comparison of source-category claims, prior-model trace initialization, a narrow reward-signal exception, internal monitorability studies, agentic safety evaluations, and governance risks against the large set of still-missing artifacts.

Use this Card to request evidence on affected episodes, reward correctness, trace provenance, evaluation integrity, and reproducibility. Do not infer a general reasoning workspace reward, reusable prior-model trace dataset, complete 4.6 recipe, or more extensive 4.6 disclosures from cross-references to 4.5.

对 Track 12 而言，Opus 4.6 有助于审计有界实现披露与已发布反馈契约之间的区别。它支持将来源类别主张、先前模型 trace 初始化、狭窄的 reward-signal 例外、内部 monitorability 研究、智能体安全评测和治理风险，与仍然缺失的大量制品进行比较。

应使用本卡片索取关于受影响 episodes、奖励正确性、trace 溯源、evaluation integrity 和可复现性的证据。不要推断一般 reasoning workspace reward、可复用的先前模型 trace 数据集、完整 4.6 配方，或从对 4.5 的交叉引用推断更广泛的 4.6 披露。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Treat the less-than-0.01% reasoning workspace-content reward-signal error as a bounded 4.6 exception, not a general reward formula or independently audited rate.
  • Keep prior-model reasoning-transcript initialization distinct from release of the traces, their prompts, rights, selection, or teacher mappings.
  • Treat the 11,000-transcript reasoning workspace experiment and 16-sample temperature-1 setting as internal assessment settings, not training or deployed inference settings.
  • Treat coding/GUI scenarios, transcript review, and interpretability methods as evaluation and audit practice; their scenarios, containers, graders, vectors, and raw artifacts remain unavailable.
  • Do not expand references to 4.5 methods into new 4.6 data, reward, or decontamination claims.

• 将小于 0.01% 的 reasoning workspace-content reward-signal 错误视为有界的 4.6 例外，而不是一般奖励公式或已独立审计的比例。
  • 将先前模型 reasoning-transcript 初始化与 traces、其 prompts、权利、选择或 teacher mappings 的发布严格区分。
  • 将 11,000-transcript reasoning workspace 实验和温度 1 下 16 samples 的设置视为内部评估设置，而不是训练或已部署推理设置。
  • 将 coding/GUI scenarios、transcript review 和可解释性方法视为评测和审计实践；其 scenarios、containers、graders、vectors 和原始制品仍不可得。
  • 不要把对 4.5 方法的引用扩展为新的 4.6 数据、奖励或去污染主张。
